localContext: Clinton Hill's tree-lined streets and vintage brownstones near Pratt Institute and Fort Greene Park create ideal conditions for wasp and hornet nests in wall voids, chimneys, eaves, and soffits. The neighborhood's mix of Victorian-era homes and prewar buildings means paper wasp and yellow jacket colonies frequently establish nests inside wall cavities and attic spaces, requiring specialized expertise to treat and remove nests without damaging historic architectural features.
